{"id":"TA-466","title":"データカタログ詳細設計：Astro × AI Search アーキテクチャ","description":"## 概要\n\nAstro（Cloudflare Workers Static Assets）をフロントエンド、**Cloudflare AI Search（AutoRAG）** をバックエンドの検索エンジンとして使い、**自然言語で検索できるデータカタログ**を構築する。\n\n**デプロイ先は Workers Static Assets（Pages は使わない）。** Workers Builds + Deploy Hooks で CI/CD を構成する。\n\n### 既存ツールとの差別化\n\n| 既存ツール | 問題 |\n| -- | -- |\n| DataHub / Amundsen | Java/Python の重いインフラ、Docker/K8s 必要 |\n| Atlan / Alation | SaaS、高コスト |\n| dbt docs | 検索がキーワード一致のみ、カスタマイズ性が低い |\n\n→ **全て Cloudflare スタック上で完結**し、「売上に関連するテーブルは？」のような曖昧なクエリにも対応できる軽量データカタログ。\n\n---\n\n## 既存リソース\n\n* **R2 バケット** `dbt-artifacts-modeling`: dbt artifacts（manifest.json, catalog.json, run_results.json 等）が**直下に**格納済み\n  * `dbt-artifacts-modeling/manifest.json`\n  * `dbt-artifacts-modeling/catalog.json`\n  * `dbt-artifacts-modeling/run_results.json`\n\n→ 既存バケット構成をそのまま活用。初期実装では直下を読み取る。\n\n---\n\n## アーキテクチャ全体像\n\n```mermaid\ngraph TB\n    subgraph SRC[\"データソース\"]\n        DBT[\"dbt artifacts<br/>manifest.json<br/>catalog.json<br/>run_results.json\"]\n        OSI[\"OSI YAML<br/>メトリクス定義\"]\n        GLOSSARY[\"用語集 MDX<br/>Git 管理\"]\n    end\n\n    subgraph STORE[\"ストレージ\"]\n        R2A[\"R2<br/>dbt-artifacts-modeling/\"]\n        R2C[\"R2<br/>data-catalog/\"]\n    end\n\n    subgraph GEN[\"カタログ生成\"]\n        WORKER[\"catalog-generator<br/>Worker\"]\n    end\n\n    subgraph SEARCH[\"検索エンジン\"]\n        AUTORAG[\"AI Search<br/>AutoRAG\"]\n        VEC[\"Vectorize<br/>自動インデックス\"]\n        WAI[\"Workers AI<br/>埋め込み + 生成\"]\n        AGW[\"AI Gateway<br/>監視・キャッシュ\"]\n    end\n\n    subgraph FRONT[\"フロントエンド — Workers Static Assets\"]\n        SSG[\"SSG ページ<br/>モデル一覧・詳細<br/>用語集\"]\n        SSR[\"SSR ページ<br/>自然言語検索<br/>類似カラム API\"]\n    end\n\n    subgraph CICD[\"CI/CD\"]\n        DH[\"Workers Deploy Hook<br/>POST → 再ビルド\"]\n        WB[\"Workers Builds<br/>Astro ビルド + デプロイ\"]\n    end\n\n    DBT -->|既に格納済み| R2A\n    R2A -->|R2 Event Notification| WORKER\n    OSI --> WORKER\n    WORKER -->|モデル Markdown| R2C\n    WORKER -->|POST| DH\n    DH --> WB\n    WB --> SSG\n    GLOSSARY -->|Content Collections| SSG\n\n    R2C -->|自動インデックス| AUTORAG\n    AUTORAG --> VEC\n    AUTORAG --> WAI\n    AUTORAG --> AGW\n\n    R2A -->|artifacts 直接読み取り| SSG\n    SSR -->|env.AI.autorag| AUTORAG\n    SSR -->|Vectorize 検索| VEC\n\n    SSG --> U[ユーザー]\n    SSR --> U\n```\n\n---\n\n## データフロー\n\n```\n既存: dbt run → dbt-artifacts-modeling/ に artifacts PUT（直下）\n\n新規:\n  1. R2 Event Notification（manifest.json 更新を検知）\n  2. → catalog-generator Worker 起動\n  3.   → manifest.json + catalog.json 読み取り → Markdown 生成\n  4.   → R2 data-catalog/models/ に PUT\n  5.   → AI Search が data-catalog/ の変更を自動検知 → インデックス更新\n  6.   → Workers Deploy Hook に POST\n  7. → Workers Builds が Astro を再ビルド → Workers Static Assets に再デプロイ\n```\n\n---\n\n## コンポーネント別設計\n\n### 1\\. R2 バケット設計\n\n**既存:**\n\n```\ndbt-artifacts-modeling/          ← 既存 R2 バケット（artifacts 格納済み）\n├── manifest.json                ← 直下に配置\n├── catalog.json\n├── run_results.json\n└── sources.json\n```\n\n**新規作成:**\n\n```\ndata-catalog/                    ← 新規 R2 バケット（AI Search 用 Markdown）\n├── models/                      ← dbt モデルのドキュメント（自動生成）\n│   ├── staging/\n│   │   └── stg_orders.md\n│   └── marts/\n│       └── fct_sales.md\n├── glossary/                    ← ビジネス用語集（AI Search 用コピー）\n│   └── revenue.md\n└── metrics/                     ← OSI メトリクス定義\n    └── revenue.md\n```\n\n### 2\\. dbt 実行 + artifacts 保存（既存フローを活用）\n\ndbt artifacts は既に `dbt-artifacts-modeling` に格納されている。dbt 実行の仕組みは既存のまま。\n\n**本 Issue で新規に作るのは「artifacts → Markdown 変換 → AI Search → Astro 再ビルド」のパイプライン。**\n\n### 3\\. catalog-generator Worker\n\nR2 Event Notification で `dbt-artifacts-modeling/manifest.json` の更新を検知し、Markdown を自動生成。最後に Workers Deploy Hook を叩いて Astro を再ビルドする。\n\n**wrangler.jsonc:**\n\n```jsonc\n{\n  \"name\": \"catalog-generator\",\n  \"compatibility_date\": \"2026-04-01\",\n  \"main\": \"src/index.ts\",\n  \"r2_buckets\": [\n    { \"binding\": \"DBT_ARTIFACTS\", \"bucket_name\": \"dbt-artifacts-modeling\" },\n    { \"binding\": \"DATA_CATALOG\", \"bucket_name\": \"data-catalog\" }\n  ],\n  \"r2_event_notifications\": {\n    \"DBT_ARTIFACTS\": [\n      {\n        \"event_type\": \"object-create\",\n        \"prefix\": \"manifest.json\"\n      }\n    ]\n  },\n  \"vars\": {\n    \"ASTRO_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL\": \"https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/workers/builds/deploy_hooks/<DEPLOY_HOOK_ID>\"\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Worker 処理フロー:**\n\n```typescript\nexport default {\n  async queue(batch: MessageBatch, env: Env) {\n    // 1. R2 から manifest.json + catalog.json を読み取り\n    const manifest = await env.DBT_ARTIFACTS.get(\"manifest.json\").then(r => r?.json());\n    const catalog = await env.DBT_ARTIFACTS.get(\"catalog.json\").then(r => r?.json());\n    if (!manifest) return;\n\n    // 2. モデルごとに Markdown 生成 → data-catalog/ に PUT\n    for (const [key, node] of Object.entries(manifest.nodes)) {\n      if (node.resource_type !== \"model\") continue;\n      const md = generateModelMarkdown(node, catalog?.nodes?.[key]);\n      const folder = node.fqn.length > 2 ? node.fqn.slice(1, -1).join(\"/\") : \"other\";\n      await env.DATA_CATALOG.put(\n        `models/${folder}/${node.name}.md`,\n        md,\n        { httpMetadata: { contentType: \"text/markdown\" } }\n      );\n    }\n    // → AI Search が data-catalog/ の変更を自動検知してインデックス更新\n\n    // 3. Workers Deploy Hook で Astro を再ビルド\n    await fetch(env.ASTRO_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL, { method: \"POST\" });\n  },\n};\n```\n\n**生成 Markdown テンプレート（モデル）:**\n\n```markdown\n# fct_sales\n\n## 概要\n日次の売上ファクトテーブル。注文確定時点の税抜き金額を記録。\n\n## テーブル情報\n- **スキーマ**: marts\n- **マテリアライゼーション**: table\n- **タグ**: なし\n\n## カラム\n\n| カラム名 | 型 | 説明 |\n|---------|------|------|\n| order_id | STRING | 注文ID（PK） |\n| amount | DECIMAL | 税抜き注文金額 |\n\n## リネージ\n- 上流: stg_orders\n```\n\n### 4\\. AI Search（AutoRAG）設定\n\nAI Search は R2 バケット `data-catalog/` のファイルを**自動でチャンク分割 → 埋め込み → Vectorize にインデックス**する。\n\n|  | 自前 RAG | AI Search（採用） |\n| -- | -- | -- |\n| チャンク分割 | 自分で実装 | **自動** |\n| 埋め込み生成 | Workers AI を直接呼ぶ | **自動** |\n| Vectorize 管理 | 自分で upsert | **自動更新**（差分検知） |\n| LLM 回答生成 | 自分で実装 | `aiSearch()` 1 行 |\n| インフラ管理 | Worker + Vectorize + AI | **ゼロ** |\n\n### 5\\. Astro フロントエンド（Workers Static Assets）\n\n**デプロイ**: `@astrojs/cloudflare` アダプタで Workers Static Assets にデプロイ。`wrangler deploy` で SSG 成果物 + SSR Worker をまとめてデプロイ。\n\n**SSG + SSR ハイブリッド:**\n\n| ページ | レンダリング | データソース |\n| -- | -- | -- |\n| モデル一覧 | **SSG** | R2 `dbt-artifacts-modeling/manifest.json` |\n| モデル詳細 | **SSG** | manifest.json + catalog.json + run_results.json |\n| 用語集一覧/詳細 | **SSG** | Content Collections（Git 内 MDX） |\n| 自然言語検索 | **SSR** | AI Search（`env.AI.autorag()`） |\n| 類似カラム検索 | **SSR** | Vectorize |\n\n**Content Collections（用語集 MDX、Astro 6）:**\n\n```typescript\n// content.config.ts\nconst glossary = defineCollection({\n  type: \"content\",\n  schema: z.object({\n    term: z.string(),\n    termEn: z.string(),\n    category: z.enum([\"財務\", \"プロダクト\", \"マーケティング\", \"エンジニアリング\"]),\n    relatedModels: z.array(z.string()).default([]),\n    relatedMetrics: z.array(z.string()).default([]),\n    owner: z.string().optional(),\n    lastReviewed: z.coerce.date().optional(),\n  }),\n});\n```\n\n**用語集 → AI Search 同期:**\nビルド時に MDX → Markdown に変換して R2 にコピー。ソースオブトゥルースは Git の MDX、R2 は AI Search 用の検索インデックスコピー。\n\n**Astro wrangler.jsonc:**\n\n```jsonc\n{\n  \"name\": \"data-catalog\",\n  \"compatibility_date\": \"2026-04-01\",\n  \"main\": \"dist/_worker.js\",\n  \"assets\": { \"directory\": \"dist\" },\n  \"ai\": { \"binding\": \"AI\" },\n  \"r2_buckets\": [\n    { \"binding\": \"DBT_ARTIFACTS\", \"bucket_name\": \"dbt-artifacts-modeling\" }\n  ],\n  \"vectorize\": [\n    { \"binding\": \"COLUMN_INDEX\", \"index_name\": \"column-similarity\" }\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n### \n\n**Workers Builds**: Astro のビルド（`astro build`）→ `wrangler deploy` を Workers Builds に任せる。\n\n**Deploy Hooks**: catalog-generator Worker が Markdown 生成完了後に POST:\n\n```\nPOST https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/workers/builds/deploy_hooks/<DEPLOY_HOOK_ID>\n```\n\n* Deploy Hook は特定ブランチ（`main`）に紐付く\n* **自動重複排除**: 短時間に複数回トリガーされても冗長ビルドはスキップ\n* レート制限: Worker あたり 10 ビルド/分、アカウントあたり 100 ビルド/分\n\n---\n\n## 実装ステップ\n\n- [ ] R2 バケット `data-catalog` 新規作成\n- [ ] catalog-generator Worker ## EXPLORATION SUMMARY: data-engineering-with-cloudflare Repository

### Overview
This is a sophisticated data engineering platform built on Cloudflare Workers, combining dbt for data transformation, Python-based dlt/ingestion workers, and a web-based data catalog interface. The architecture leverages Cloudflare's serverless infrastructure for ETL/ELT pipelines.

### 1. MODELING DIRECTORY STRUCTURE & R2 ARTIFACT UPLOAD

**Primary Files:**
- `/modeling/wrangler.jsonc` - Cloudflare Worker configuration
- `/modeling/src/index.ts` - HTTP endpoints and request router
- `/modeling/src/workflow.ts` - Cloudflare Workflows orchestration (too large to fully read, but referenced in context)
- `/modeling/Dockerfile` - Container environment for dbt execution
- `/modeling/dbt_project.yml` - dbt Data Vault 2.0 configuration
- `/modeling/profiles.yml` - Snowflake connection configuration
- `/modeling/pyproject.toml` - Python dependencies (uv-managed)

**R2 Artifact Upload Mechanism:**
The workflow uploads dbt artifacts to R2 bucket `dbt-artifacts-modeling`:
1. Workflow runs dbt commands in isolated Sandbox container
2. After successful dbt run, docs are generated
3. Artifacts are uploaded to R2 via bindings in wrangler.jsonc
4. Static dbt docs are served from R2 at `/docs` endpoint
5. Raw artifacts accessible via `/artifacts/{key}` endpoint

**Wrangler Configuration (wrangler.jsonc):**
- Worker name: `modeling`
- Durable Object: `Sandbox` class (max 1 instance, basic tier)
- Workflow binding: `DBT_BUILD_WORKFLOW` (class: DbtBuildWorkflow)
- R2 binding: `DBT_ARTIFACTS` → `dbt-artifacts-modeling` bucket
- Cron trigger: Sunday 18:00 UTC (Monday 03:00 JST)
- Migrations: v1 (DbtContainer), v2 (JobRegistry), v3 (Sandbox - current)

**Worker Endpoints (src/index.ts):**
- `GET /health` - Public liveness probe
- `GET /health/deep` - Readiness probe (Snowflake connectivity check)
- `POST /restart` - Force restart Sandbox container
- `POST /workflows/build` - Kick off dbt build workflow
- `GET /workflows/build/instances/{id}` - Check workflow status
- `GET /docs` & `GET /docs/{path}` - Serve dbt docs from R2
- `GET /artifacts/{key}` - Serve raw artifacts from R2

All endpoints except `/health` require Bearer token authentication via `API_KEY` secret.

**Sandbox Container (Dockerfile):**
- Base: `cloudflare/sandbox:0.7.0`
- Installs `uv` package manager for Python
- Pre-warms uv cache with dbt dependencies for faster cold starts
- Sets `UV_COMPILE_BYTECODE=1` for pre-compiled bytecode
- Exposes port 8080

**dbt Project Configuration (dbt_project.yml):**
- Data Vault 2.0 architecture using datavault4dbt package
- Multi-database layout:
  - **staging** database: Source data staging
  - **raw_vault** database: Hub, link, satellite tables
  - **business_vault** database: PIT (Point-in-Time) tables, bridges
  - **marts** database: Kimball dimensions and facts
- Thread count: 8 (for both dev and prod targets)
- HashType: MD5, InputCaseSensitivity: FALSE

**Snowflake Profiles (profiles.yml):**
- **dev target**: Forces all models into single DEVELOPMENT database
- **prod target**: Uses multi-database config from dbt_project.yml
- Credentials via environment variables (Snowflake private key auth)
- client_session_keep_alive: false (optimized for Cloudflare's environment)

### 2. DBT PROJECT STRUCTURE & MODELS

**Staging Models (staging/):**
- datavault folder: Healthcare source models (patients, doctors, visits, etc.)
- Jaffle Shop starter models: stg_customers, stg_locations, stg_orders, stg_order_items, stg_products, stg_supplies

**Raw Vault Models (raw_vault/):**
- **Hubs (6):** hub_patient, hub_doctor, hub_visit, hub_department, hub_medication, hub_insurance_company
- **Links (3):** link_visit, link_prescription, link_patient_insurance
- **Satellites (8):** Patient/doctor/visit/department/medication/insurance/prescription details, plus patient_insurance details

**Business Vault Models (business_vault/):**
- pit_patient (Point-in-Time)
- bridge_patient_medication
- sat_patient_visit_summary

**Marts (marts/):**
- General Kimball models: customers, orders, order_items, products, supplies, locations
- **Dimensions:** dim_patient, dim_doctor, dim_medication, dim_date, metricflow_time_spine
- **Facts:** fct_prescriptions, fct_visits

### 3. R2 BUCKET CONFIGURATIONS ACROSS PROJECT

**Identified R2 Buckets:**

| Bucket Name | Binding Name | Location | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dbt-artifacts-modeling` | `DBT_ARTIFACTS` | `/modeling/wrangler.jsonc` | dbt docs & artifacts storage |
| `data-lake` | `DATA_LAKE` | `/ingestion/wrangler.jsonc` | Raw ingestion data storage |
| `data-lake` | `DATA_LAKE` | `/agents/wrangler.jsonc` | Agent-processed data storage |

**Note:** No `transform/core/` directory exists. The modeling directory is the primary dbt orchestration layer.

### 4. DATA-CATALOG-APP DIRECTORY STRUCTURE

**Root Configuration Files:**
- `astro.config.mjs` - Astro SSG configuration with Cloudflare & React adapters
- `wrangler.jsonc` - Cloudflare Worker deployment config (name: "flame")
- `package.json` - Node.js dependencies and build scripts

**Key Dependencies:**
- **Astro:** 6.1.7 (static site generator)
- **React:** 19.2.5 (interactive components)
- **Tailwind CSS:** 4.2.2 (styling)
- **@cloudflare/kumo:** 1.18.0 (Cloudflare design system)
- **Wrangler:** 4.83.0 (deployment tool)
- **Node requirement:** >=22.12.0

**Source Directory Structure (src/):**
```
src/
├── layouts/
│   └── Layout.astro
├── components/
│   ├── DataCatalog.tsx (React component)
│   └── AppSidebar.tsx (React component)
└── pages/
    └── index.astro (root page)
```

**Layout.astro:**
- Title: "Flame - Data Catalog"
- Imports global.css and uses Kumo design tokens (bg-kumo-base, text-kumo-default)

**DataCatalog.tsx:**
- React component using Kumo UI components: Badge, Button, Input, Surface, Table, Tabs, Text
- Hardcoded dataset mock data (currently 5 datasets): github_events, github_repos, cloudflare_analytics, user_sessions, dbt_staging_events
- StatusBadge component for active/stale status display
- Uses useState for local component state

**AppSidebar.tsx:**
- Navigation using Kumo Sidebar component
- Menu items: House (Home), MagnifyingGlass (Search), TableIcon (Datasets)
- Settings in footer
- Uses Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for UI elements

**Wrangler Deployment Config (wrangler.jsonc):**
- Name: "flame"
- Main: "@astrojs/cloudflare/entrypoints/server" (SSR handler)
- Assets directory: "./dist"
- Compatibility date: "2025-04-01"
- Observability: enabled

### 5. GITHUB ACTIONS WORKFLOWS

**Location:** `/Users/ta93abe/Developer/github.com/ta93abe/data-engineering-with-cloudflare/.github/workflows/`

**biome-check.yml:**
- Runs on `ingestion/` directory changes
- Executes Biome code quality checks
- Prevents non-conforming code from merging

**d1-migrations.yml:**
- Applies D1 database migrations
- Uses `wrangler-action@v3`
- Targets `infrastructure/d1` directory
- Part of database schema management pipeline

**claude.yml:**
- GitHub Actions workflow triggering Claude Code agent
- Activation triggers: issue comments, PR reviews, issues with @claude mentions
- Enables AI-assisted code review and issue resolution

### ARCHITECTURE INSIGHTS

**Data Flow:**
1. **Ingestion layer** (ingestion/) → Raw data uploaded to R2 `data-lake` bucket
2. **Transformation layer** (modeling/) → dbt reads from Snowflake, runs models, outputs to Snowflake
3. **Orchestration** → Cloudflare Workflows manages long-running dbt jobs with retry logic
4. **Artifact storage** → dbt docs and artifacts uploaded to R2 `dbt-artifacts-modeling`
5. **Data catalog** (data-catalog-app/) → Astro site displays data assets to users

**Runtime Architecture:**
- **Worker:** Cloudflare Worker receiving HTTP requests
- **Durable Object:** Singleton Sandbox container managing dbt execution isolation
- **Workflow:** Long-running async workflow for dbt jobs with status polling
- **Container:** Docker container with Python, uv, and dbt pre-cached
- **Secrets Management:** Environment variables for Snowflake credentials and API keys

**Key Design Patterns:**
- Bearer token authentication for all non-public endpoints
- Workflow retry logic (3 attempts) with exponential backoff
- Status polling pattern for long-running dbt jobs
- Static site generation for data catalog (Astro + React)
- Design system integration (Kumo) for consistent UI

---

This completes the thorough exploration of the data-engineering-with-cloudflare repository across all requested areas.

1	import {
2	  WorkflowEntrypoint,
3	  type WorkflowEvent,
4	  type WorkflowStep,
5	} from "cloudflare:workers";
6	import { getSandbox, type Sandbox } from "@cloudflare/sandbox";
7	
8	/**
9	 * DbtBuildWorkflow
10	 * ----------------
11	 * Orchestrates a dbt build end-to-end against a Cloudflare Sandbox
12	 * container. The sandbox gives us:
13	 *
14	 *   - `gitCheckout()` to pull a fresh copy of this repository at
15	 *     runtime so model changes don't require a container image
16	 *     rebuild.
17	 *   - `writeFile()` to drop a fully-resolved `profiles.yml` on
18	 *     disk built from Worker secrets, so no Snowflake credentials
19	 *     are ever baked into the image or committed to Git.
20	 *   - `startProcess()` + process polling for long-running dbt
21	 *     commands that would otherwise blow the Worker subrequest
22	 *     wall clock.
23	 *
24	 * Workflow steps use `step.do` for retriable units of work and
25	 * `step.sleep` for durable polling waits so the Workflow runtime
26	 * can hibernate across the entire dbt build duration without
27	 * holding CPU or memory.
28	 */
29	
30	export interface DbtBuildWorkflowParams {
31	  command?:
32	    | "build"
33	    | "build-docs"
34	    | "run"
35	    | "test"
36	    | "seed"
37	    | "docs"
38	    | "docs-generate";
39	  target?: "dev" | "prod";
40	  select?: string;
41	  full_refresh?: boolean;
42	  source?: string; // 'cron' | 'webhook' | 'manual'
43	  ref?: string; // git ref to build, defaults to main
44	}
45	
46	interface WorkflowEnv {
47	  Sandbox: DurableObjectNamespace<Sandbox>;
48	  DBT_ARTIFACTS: R2Bucket;
49	  API_KEY: string;
50	  SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT: string;
51	  SNOWFLAKE_USER: string;
52	  SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY: string;
53	  SNOWFLAKE_ROLE?: string;
54	  SNOWFLAKE_WAREHOUSE?: string;
55	  SNOWFLAKE_DATABASE?: string;
56	  SNOWFLAKE_SCHEMA?: string;
57	  SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL?: string;
58	  REPO_URL?: string;
59	}
60	
61	const SANDBOX_ID = "dbt-runner-main";
62	const WORKSPACE_ROOT = "/workspace/repo";
63	const MODELING_DIR = `${WORKSPACE_ROOT}/modeling`;
64	const DEFAULT_REPO_URL =
65	  "https://github.com/ta93abe/data-engineering-with-cloudflare";
66	const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3;
67	const POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 30;
68	const MAX_POLL_ITERATIONS = 240; // 240 * 30s = 2 hours per attempt
69	const RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS = 60;
70	
71	interface DbtResult {
72	  exitCode: number;
73	  stdout_tail: string;
74	  stderr_tail: string;
75	  duration_ms: number;
76	}
77	
78	export class DbtBuildWorkflow extends WorkflowEntrypoint<
79	  WorkflowEnv,
80	  DbtBuildWorkflowParams
81	> {
82	  async run(
83	    event: WorkflowEvent<DbtBuildWorkflowParams>,
84	    step: WorkflowStep
85	  ): Promise<DbtResult> {
86	    const payload = event.payload ?? {};
87	    const command = payload.command ?? "build-docs";
88	    const target = payload.target ?? "prod";
89	    const select = payload.select;
90	    const full_refresh = payload.full_refresh ?? false;
91	    const ref = payload.ref ?? "main";
92	    const source = payload.source ?? "manual";
93	    const repoUrl = this.env.REPO_URL ?? DEFAULT_REPO_URL;
94	
95	    // Step 1: prepare the workspace via git clone
96	    await step.do(
97	      "workspace-prepare",
98	      { retries: { limit: 3, delay: "15 seconds", backoff: "exponential" } },
99	      async () => {
100	        const sandbox = getSandbox(this.env.Sandbox, SANDBOX_ID);
101	        await sandbox.exec(`rm -rf ${WORKSPACE_ROOT}`);
102	        await sandbox.gitCheckout(repoUrl, {
103	          branch: ref,
104	          targetDir: WORKSPACE_ROOT,
105	        });
106	      }
107	    );
108	
109	    // Step 2: materialize profiles.yml from worker secrets
110	    await step.do(
111	      "write-profiles",
112	      { retries: { limit: 3, delay: "5 seconds", backoff: "exponential" } },
113	      async () => {
114	        const sandbox = getSandbox(this.env.Sandbox, SANDBOX_ID);
115	        const profiles = buildProfilesYaml({
116	          account: this.env.SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT,
117	          user: this.env.SNOWFLAKE_USER,
118	          privateKeyPem: this.env.SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY,
119	          role: this.env.SNOWFLAKE_ROLE ?? "ACCOUNTADMIN",
120	          warehouse: this.env.SNOWFLAKE_WAREHOUSE ?? "COMPUTE_WH",
121	          database: this.env.SNOWFLAKE_DATABASE ?? "DEVELOPMENT",
122	          schema: this.env.SNOWFLAKE_SCHEMA ?? "PUBLIC",
123	        });
124	        await sandbox.writeFile(`${MODELING_DIR}/profiles.yml`, profiles);
125	      }
126	    );
127	
128	    // Step 3: install python + dbt dependencies (uses uv cache warmed in image)
129	    await step.do(
130	      "install-deps",
131	      { retries: { limit: 3, delay: "30 seconds", backoff: "exponential" } },
132	      async () => {
133	        const sandbox = getSandbox(this.env.Sandbox, SANDBOX_ID);
134	        const sync = await sandbox.exec("uv sync --no-dev --frozen", {
135	          cwd: MODELING_DIR,
136	          timeout: 600_000,
137	        });
138	        if (sync.exitCode !== 0) {
139	          throw new Error(`uv sync failed: ${sync.stderr}`);
140	        }
141	        const deps = await sandbox.exec("uv run dbt deps", {
142	          cwd: MODELING_DIR,
143	          timeout: 600_000,
144	        });
145	        if (deps.exitCode !== 0) {
146	          throw new Error(`dbt deps failed: ${deps.stderr}`);
147	        }
148	      }
149	    );
150	
151	    // "docs-generate" short-circuits the build retry loop and just
152	    // runs `dbt docs generate` + R2 upload. Useful for
153	    // regenerating docs against whatever is already in Snowflake
154	    // without paying for a full model rebuild.
155	    if (command === "docs-generate") {
156	      return await this.runDocsGenerate(step, target, source, ref);
157	    }
158	
159	    // "build-docs" is not a real dbt command -- it's a workflow
160	    // convenience that means "run dbt build, then dbt docs
161	    // generate on success". The retry loop below runs the
162	    // primary command; docs generate happens once at the end.
163	    const dbtPrimary = command === "build-docs" ? "build" : command;
164	
165	    // Step 4: run dbt with 3-attempt retry loop
166	    let lastResult: DbtResult | null = null;
167	    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= MAX_ATTEMPTS; attempt++) {
168	      const processId = `dbt-${dbtPrimary}-${event.instanceId}-${attempt}`;
169	
170	      const started = await step.do(
171	        `dbt-start-attempt-${attempt}`,
172	        { retries: { limit: 3, delay: "15 seconds", backoff: "exponential" } },
173	        async () => {
174	          const sandbox = getSandbox(this.env.Sandbox, SANDBOX_ID);
175	          const args = ["dbt", dbtPrimary, "--target", target, "--profiles-dir", "."];
176	          if (select) args.push("--select", select);
177	          if (full_refresh) args.push("--full-refresh");
178	          const cmdLine = `uv run ${args.map(shellQuote).join(" ")}`;
179	          await sandbox.startProcess(cmdLine, {
180	            cwd: MODELING_DIR,
181	            processId,
182	            autoCleanup: true,
183	          });
184	          return { processId };
185	        }
186	      );
187	
188	      let finalExitCode: number | null = null;
189	      let finalLogs = "";
190	      let polls = 0;
191	      while (polls < MAX_POLL_ITERATIONS) {
192	        await step.sleep(
193	          `poll-sleep-${attempt}-${polls}`,
194	          `${POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS} seconds`
195	        );
196	        const snapshot = await step.do(
197	          `poll-check-${attempt}-${polls}`,
198	          { retries: { limit: 3, delay: "15 seconds", backoff: "exponential" } },
199	          async () => {
200	            const sandbox = getSandbox(this.env.Sandbox, SANDBOX_ID);
201	            const proc = await sandbox.getProcess(started.processId);
202	            if (proc === null) {
203	              // Process already reaped by the sandbox; treat as done.
204	              return { status: "completed" as const, exitCode: null as number | null };
205	            }
206	            const status = await proc.getStatus();
207	            const terminal = new Set([
208	              "completed",
209	              "failed",
210	              "killed",
211	              "error",
212	            ]);
213	            const exitCode = terminal.has(status)
214	              ? ((proc as unknown as { exitCode?: number }).exitCode ?? null)
215	              : null;
216	            return { status, exitCode };
217	          }
218	        );
219	        if (
220	          snapshot.status === "completed" ||
221	          snapshot.status === "failed" ||
222	          snapshot.status === "killed" ||
223	          snapshot.status === "error"
224	        ) {
225	          const final = await step.do(
226	            `collect-${attempt}-${polls}`,
227	            { retries: { limit: 3, delay: "5 seconds", backoff: "exponential" } },
228	            async () => {
229	              const sandbox = getSandbox(this.env.Sandbox, SANDBOX_ID);
230	              const logs = await sandbox.getProcessLogs(started.processId);
231	              return {
232	                stdout: logs.stdout,
233	                stderr: logs.stderr,
234	              };
235	            }
236	          );
237	          finalExitCode =
238	            snapshot.exitCode ??
239	            (snapshot.status === "completed" ? 0 : 1);
240	          finalLogs = `${final.stdout}\n${final.stderr}`;
241	          break;
242	        }
243	        polls++;
244	      }
245	
246	      if (finalExitCode === null) {
247	        await step.do(
248	          `kill-stalled-${attempt}`,
249	          { retries: { limit: 1, delay: "5 seconds" } },
250	          async () => {
251	            const sandbox = getSandbox(this.env.Sandbox, SANDBOX_ID);
252	            await sandbox.killProcess(started.processId);
253	          }
254	        );
255	        finalExitCode = 124;
256	        finalLogs = "timed out waiting for dbt process";
257	      }
258	
259	      lastResult = {
260	        exitCode: finalExitCode,
261	        stdout_tail: tail(finalLogs, 1500),
262	        stderr_tail: "",
263	        duration_ms: polls * POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS * 1000,
264	      };
265	
266	      if (finalExitCode === 0) {
267	        // If the caller asked for "build-docs", also run
268	        // `dbt docs generate` on the freshly-built project.
269	        // This is post-build; if it fails the overall build is
270	        // still considered successful, but the Slack message
271	        // calls out the docs failure so operators can retry.
272	        let docsWarning = "";
273	        if (command === "build-docs") {
274	          const docsOutcome = await step.do(
275	            "dbt-docs-generate",
276	            { retries: { limit: 2, delay: "30 seconds", backoff: "exponential" } },
277	            async () => {
278	              const sandbox = getSandbox(this.env.Sandbox, SANDBOX_ID);
279	              const docsCmd = `uv run dbt docs generate --target ${shellQuote(target)} --profiles-dir .`;
280	              const result = await sandbox.exec(docsCmd, {
281	                cwd: MODELING_DIR,
282	                timeout: 1_800_000, // 30 min
283	              });
284	              return {
285	                exitCode: result.exitCode,
286	                stdout: result.stdout,
287	                stderr: result.stderr,
288	              };
289	            }
290	          );
291	          if (docsOutcome.exitCode !== 0) {
292	            docsWarning =
293	              `\n:warning: docs generate failed: exit=${docsOutcome.exitCode}` +
294	              `\n\`\`\`\n${tail(docsOutcome.stderr || docsOutcome.stdout, 800)}\n\`\`\``;
295	          }
296	        }
297	
298	        // Persist dbt artifacts to R2 so /docs and /artifacts/* can
299	        // serve them after the sandbox is destroyed. run_results.json
300	        // and manifest.json come from `dbt build`; index.html and
301	        // catalog.json come from `dbt docs generate`.
302	        const uploadWarning = await step.do(
303	          "upload-artifacts",
304	          { retries: { limit: 2, delay: "15 seconds", backoff: "exponential" } },
305	          async () => {
306	            const sandbox = getSandbox(this.env.Sandbox, SANDBOX_ID);
307	            const targets: Array<{ file: string; contentType: string }> = [
308	              { file: "run_results.json", contentType: "application/json" },
309	              { file: "manifest.json", contentType: "application/json" },
310	            ];
311	            if (command === "build-docs") {
312	              targets.push(
313	                { file: "index.html", contentType: "text/html; charset=utf-8" },
314	                { file: "catalog.json", contentType: "application/json" }
315	              );
316	            }
317	            const failures: string[] = [];
318	            for (const { file, contentType } of targets) {
319	              try {
320	                const read = await sandbox.readFile(
321	                  `${MODELING_DIR}/target/${file}`
322	                );
323	                await this.env.DBT_ARTIFACTS.put(file, read.content, {
324	                  httpMetadata: { contentType },
325	                });
326	              } catch (e) {
327	                failures.push(`${file}: ${(e as Error).message}`);
328	              }
329	            }
330	            return failures;
331	          }
332	        );
333	        let uploadNote = "";
334	        if (uploadWarning.length > 0) {
335	          uploadNote =
336	            `\n:warning: artifact upload partial failure:\n\`\`\`\n${uploadWarning.join("\n")}\n\`\`\``;
337	        }
338	
339	        await step.do(
340	          "notify-success",
341	          { retries: { limit: 3, delay: "15 seconds", backoff: "exponential" } },
342	          async () =>
343	            this.notifySlack(
344	              `:white_check_mark: dbt *${command}* succeeded on \`${target}\`` +
345	                (select ? ` (\`${select}\`)` : "") +
346	                `\nattempt: ${attempt}/${MAX_ATTEMPTS}` +
347	                `\nsource: ${source}` +
348	                `\nref: ${ref}` +
349	                docsWarning +
350	                uploadNote
351	            )
352	        );
353	        return lastResult;
354	      }
355	
356	      if (attempt < MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
357	        await step.do(
358	          `notify-retry-${attempt}`,
359	          { retries: { limit: 1, delay: "5 seconds" } },
360	          async () =>
361	            this.notifySlack(
362	              `:repeat: dbt *${command}* on \`${target}\` failed (attempt ${attempt}/${MAX_ATTEMPTS}), retrying\n\`\`\`\n${tail(finalLogs, 800)}\n\`\`\``
363	            )
364	        );
365	        await step.sleep(
366	          `retry-backoff-${attempt}`,
367	          `${RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS} seconds`
368	        );
369	      }
370	    }
371	
372	    await step.do(
373	      "notify-failure",
374	      { retries: { limit: 3, delay: "15 seconds", backoff: "exponential" } },
375	      async () =>
376	        this.notifySlack(
377	          `:x: dbt *${command}* on \`${target}\` *failed* after ${MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts` +
378	            `\nexit: ${lastResult?.exitCode ?? "n/a"}` +
379	            `\n\`\`\`\n${(lastResult?.stdout_tail ?? "").slice(-1500)}\n\`\`\``
380	        )
381	    );
382	
383	    throw new Error(
384	      `dbt ${command} on ${target} failed after ${MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts`
385	    );
386	  }
387	
388	  private async runDocsGenerate(
389	    step: WorkflowStep,
390	    target: string,
391	    source: string,
392	    ref: string
393	  ): Promise<DbtResult> {
394	    const started = Date.now();
395	    const result = await step.do(
396	      "dbt-docs-generate",
397	      { retries: { limit: 2, delay: "30 seconds", backoff: "exponential" } },
398	      async () => {
399	        const sandbox = getSandbox(this.env.Sandbox, SANDBOX_ID);
400	        const docsCmd = `uv run dbt docs generate --target ${shellQuote(target)} --profiles-dir .`;
401	        const r = await sandbox.exec(docsCmd, {
402	          cwd: MODELING_DIR,
403	          timeout: 1_800_000,
404	        });
405	        return { exitCode: r.exitCode, stdout: r.stdout, stderr: r.stderr };
406	      }
407	    );
408	
409	    if (result.exitCode !== 0) {
410	      await step.do("notify-docs-generate-failure", async () =>
411	        this.notifySlack(
412	          `:x: dbt *docs-generate* on \`${target}\` failed (exit ${result.exitCode})` +
413	            `\n\`\`\`\n${tail(result.stderr || result.stdout, 1500)}\n\`\`\``
414	        )
415	      );
416	      throw new Error(`dbt docs generate failed: exit=${result.exitCode}`);
417	    }
418	
419	    const failures = await step.do(
420	      "upload-artifacts-docs-generate",
421	      { retries: { limit: 2, delay: "15 seconds", backoff: "exponential" } },
422	      async () => {
423	        const sandbox = getSandbox(this.env.Sandbox, SANDBOX_ID);
424	        const targets: Array<{ file: string; contentType: string }> = [
425	          { file: "index.html", contentType: "text/html; charset=utf-8" },
426	          { file: "catalog.json", contentType: "application/json" },
427	          { file: "manifest.json", contentType: "application/json" },
428	        ];
429	        const failed: string[] = [];
430	        for (const { file, contentType } of targets) {
431	          try {
432	            const read = await sandbox.readFile(
433	              `${MODELING_DIR}/target/${file}`
434	            );
435	            await this.env.DBT_ARTIFACTS.put(file, read.content, {
436	              httpMetadata: { contentType },
437	            });
438	          } catch (e) {
439	            failed.push(`${file}: ${(e as Error).message}`);
440	          }
441	        }
442	        return failed;
443	      }
444	    );
445	    const uploadNote =
446	      failures.length > 0
447	        ? `\n:warning: artifact upload partial failure:\n\`\`\`\n${failures.join("\n")}\n\`\`\``
448	        : "";
449	
450	    await step.do("notify-docs-generate-success", async () =>
451	      this.notifySlack(
452	        `:white_check_mark: dbt *docs-generate* succeeded on \`${target}\`` +
453	          `\nsource: ${source}` +
454	          `\nref: ${ref}` +
455	          uploadNote
456	      )
457	    );
458	
459	    return {
460	      exitCode: 0,
461	      stdout_tail: tail(result.stdout, 1500),
462	      stderr_tail: "",
463	      duration_ms: Date.now() - started,
464	    };
465	  }
466	
467	  private async notifySlack(text: string): Promise<void> {
468	    if (!this.env.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL) return;
469	    try {
470	      await fetch(this.env.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, {
471	        method: "POST",
472	        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
473	        body: JSON.stringify({ text }),
474	      });
475	    } catch (e) {
476	      console.warn("slack notify failed", e);
477	    }
478	  }
479	}

484	
485	interface ProfilesInput {
486	  account: string;
487	  user: string;
488	  privateKeyPem: string;
489	  role: string;
490	  warehouse: string;
491	  database: string;
492	  schema: string;
493	}
494	
495	function buildProfilesYaml(input: ProfilesInput): string {
496	  const keyLines = input.privateKeyPem
497	    .split("\n")
498	    .map((line) => `        ${line}`)
499	    .join("\n");
500	
501	  return `modeling:
502	  target: prod
503	  outputs:
504	    prod:
505	      type: snowflake
506	      account: ${input.account}
507	      user: ${input.user}
508	      private_key: |
509	${keyLines}
510	      role: ${input.role}
511	      warehouse: ${input.warehouse}
512	      database: ${input.database}
513	      schema: ${input.schema}
514	      threads: 8
515	      client_session_keep_alive: false
516	`;
517	}
518	
519	function shellQuote(arg: string): string {
520	  if (/^[a-zA-Z0-9._\-+/=:@,]+$/.test(arg)) return arg;
521	  return `'${arg.replace(/'/g, "'\\''")}'`;
522	}
523	
524	function tail(text: string, maxChars: number): string {
525	  if (text.length <= maxChars) return text;
526	  return text.slice(text.length - maxChars);
527	}

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- **SSG vs SSR の判断**: Issue設計ではモデル一覧/詳細をSSGとしているが、Astro + Cloudflareアダプタではビルド時にR2バインディングへアクセスできない（ビルドはNode.jsで動く）。SSRにして Workers エッジで配信すれば十分高速で、R2への直接アクセスも可能
- **スコープ分割**: TA-466は4つの独立サブシステム（Astro UI、catalog-generator Worker、AI Search インフラ、CI/CD）を含む。data-catalog-app配下に集中するプランを書き、他は別プランとして分離する
- **既存artifacts構造**: modeling Workerが既に `manifest.json`, `catalog.json`, `run_results.json`, `index.html` をR2 `dbt-artifacts-modeling` に直下格納している。これをそのまま読み取れば即座に実データを表示可能
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

DbtManifestNode>;\n  sources: Record<string, DbtManifestNode>;\n  metadata: {\n    dbt_version: string;\n    generated_at: string;\n    project_name: string;\n  };\n  parent_map: Record<string, }\n  >;\n}\n\nexport interface DbtCatalog {\n  nodes: Record<string, DbtCatalogNode>;\n  sources: Record<string, DbtCatalogNode>;\n  metadata: {\n    generated_at: string;\n  };\n}\n\n// --- });\n});\n\ndescribe(\"transformManifestNode\", () => {\n  it(\"transforms a manifest node into a CatalogModel\", () => {\n    const node = makeNode();\n    const catalogNode = makeCatalogNode();\n    const runResult: DbtRunResult = {\n      unique_id: \"model.modeling.fct_visits\",\n      status: \"success\",\n      execution_time: 2.5,\n      message: \"OK\",\n    };\n    const childMap = { expect(result.name).toBe(\"fct_visits\");\n    expect(result.layer).toBe(\"marts\");\n    expect(result.materialization).toBe(\"table\");\n    expect(result.columns).toHaveLength(1);\n './artifacts'\"\n\n- [ ] **Step 8: Implement artifacts client**\n\n```typescript\n// data-catalog-app/src/lib/artifacts.ts\nimport type {\n  DbtManifest,\n  DbtCatalog,\n  DbtRunResults,\n  DbtManifestNode,\n  DbtCatalogNode,\n  DbtRunResult,\n  CatalogModel,\n  CatalogColumn,\n} from \"./types\";\n\ntype Layer = CatalogModel[\"layer\"];\nconst KNOWN_LAYERS: Layer[] = [\"staging\", \"raw_vault\", \"business_vault\", \"marts\"];\n\nexport function inferLayer(fqn: string[]): Layer {\n  for (const segment of fqn) {\n    if (KNOWN_LAYERS.includes(segment as Layer)) {\n      return segment as Layer;\n    }\n  }\n  return \"other\";\n}\n\nexport function transformManifestNode(\n  node: DbtManifestNode,\n  catalogNode: DbtCatalogNode | undefined,\n  runResult: DbtRunResult | undefined,\n  childMap: Record<string, string[]>\n): CatalogModel {\n  const columns: CatalogColumn[] = catalogNode\n    ? Object.values(catalogNode.columns).map((col) => ({\n        name: col.name,\n        type: col.type,\n        description:\n          node.columns[col.name.toLowerCase()]?.description ??\n          node.columns[col.name]?.description ??\n          \"\",\n        index: col.index,\n      }))\n    : Object.values(node.columns).map((col, i) => ({\n        name: col.name,\n        type: col.data_type ?? \"unknown\",\n        description: col.description,\n        index: i + 1,\n      }));\n\n  columns.sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index);\n\n  return {\n    uniqueId: node.unique_id,\n    name: node.name,\n    description: node.description,\n    schema: node.schema,\n    database: node.database,\n    materialization: node.config.materialized,\n    layer: inferLayer(node.fqn),\n    tags: node.tags,\n    columns,\n    dependsOn: node.depends_on.nodes,\n    referencedBy: childMap[node.unique_id] ?? [],\n    lastRunStatus: runResult?.status ?? null,\n    lastRunTime: runResult?.execution_time ?? null,\n    path: node.path,\n  };\n}\n\nasync function fetchJson<T>(bucket: R2Bucket, key: string): Promise<T | null> {\n  const obj = await bucket.get(key);\n  if (!obj) return null;\n  return obj.json() as Promise<T>;\n}\n\nexport async function loadAllModels(bucket: R2Bucket): Promise<CatalogModel[]> {\n  const [manifest, catalog, runResults] = await Promise.all([\n    fetchJson<DbtManifest>(bucket, \"manifest.json\"),\n    fetchJson<DbtCatalog>(bucket, \"catalog.json\"),\n    fetchJson<DbtRunResults>(bucket, \"run_results.json\"),\n  ]);\n\n  if (!manifest) return [];\n\n  const runResultMap = new Map(\n    (runResults?.results ?? []).map((r) => [r.unique_id, r])\n  );\n\n  const models: CatalogModel[] = [];\n  for (const [key, node] of Object.entries(manifest.nodes)) {\n    if (node.resource_type !== \"model\") continue;\n    models.push(\n      transformManifestNode(\n        node,\n        catalog?.nodes?.[key],\n        runResultMap.get(key),\n        manifest.child_map ?? {}\n      )\n    );\n  }\n\n  models.sort((a, b) => {\n    const layerOrder = [\"marts\", \"business_vault\", \"raw_vault\", \"staging\", \"other\"];\n    const la = layerOrder.indexOf(a.layer);\n    const lb = layerOrder.indexOf(b.layer);\n    if (la !== lb) return la - lb;\n    return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);\n  });\n\n  return models;\n}\n\nexport async function loadModel(\n  bucket: R2Bucket,\n  modelName: string\n): Promise<CatalogModel | null> {\n  const models = await loadAllModels(bucket);\n  return models.find((m) => m.name === modelName) ?? null;\n}\n\nexport async function loadManifestMetadata(\n  bucket: R2Bucket\n): Promise<{ dbtVersion: string; generatedAt: string } | null> {\n  const manifest = await fetchJson<DbtManifest>(bucket, \"manifest.json\");\n  if (!manifest) return null;\n  return {\n    dbtVersion: manifest.metadata.dbt_version,\n    generatedAt: manifest.metadata.generated_at,\n  };\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 9: Run tests to verify they pass**\n\nRun: `cd data-catalog-app && pnpm component**\n\n```tsx\n// data-catalog-app/src/components/ModelList.tsx\nimport { Badge, Input, Surface, Table, Tabs, Text } from \"@cloudflare/kumo\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\nimport === \"skipped\") return <Badge variant=\"outline\">Skipped</Badge>;\n  return <Badge variant=\"outline\">Unknown</Badge>;\n}\n\nfunction LayerBadge({ layer }: { layer: CatalogModel[\"layer\"] }) {\n  const variants: Record<string, \"blue\" | \"purple\" | \"orange\" | \"green\" | \"outline\"> = {\n    marts: \"green\",\n    business_vault: \"purple\",\n    raw_vault: \"blue\",\n    staging: \"orange\",\n    other: \"outline\",\n  };\n  return <Badge variant={variants[layer] ?? \"outline\"}>{layer}</Badge>;\n}\n\nconst LAYER_TABS = [\n  { value: \"all\", label: \"All Models\" },\n  { value: \"marts\", label: \"Marts\" },\n  { value: \"business_vault\", label: \"Business Vault\" },\n  { value: \"raw_vault\", label: \"Raw Vault\" },\n  { value: \"staging\", label: \"Staging\" },\n] as const;\n\ninterface Props {\n  models: CatalogModel[];\n}\n\nexport function ModelList({ models }: Props) {\n  const [search, setSearch] = useState(\"\");\n  const [selectedLayer, setSelectedLayer] = useState(\"all\");\n\n  const filtered = models.filter((m) => {\n    if (selectedLayer !== \"all\" && m.layer !== selectedLayer) return false;\n    if (!search) return true;\n    const q = search.toLowerCase();\n    return (\n      m.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||\n      m.description.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||\n      m.schema.toLowerCase().includes(q)\n    );\n  });\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex flex-1 flex-col gap-6 p-6\">\n      <div>\n        <Text className=\"text-2xl font-bold\">Models</Text>\n        <Text className=\"text-kumo-subtle text-sm\">\n          {models.length} dbt models across your data platform\n        </Text>\n      </div>\n\n      <Tabs\n        variant=\"underline\"\n        tabs={LAYER_TABS.map((t) => ({ ...t }))}\n        selectedValue={selectedLayer}\n        onValueChange={setSelectedLayer}\n      />\n\n      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-4\">\n        <div className=\"flex-1\">\n          <Input\n            aria-label=\"Search models\"\n            placeholder=\"Search by name, description, or schema...\"\n            value={search}\n            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}\n          />\n        </div>\n        <Text className=\"text-kumo-subtle text-sm whitespace-nowrap\">\n          {filtered.length} model{filtered.length !== 1 ? \"s\" : \"\"}\n        </Text>\n      </div>\n\n      <Surface className=\"overflow-hidden rounded-lg\">\n        <Table>\n          <Table.Header>\n            <Table.Row>\n              <Table.Head>Name</Table.Head>\n              <Table.Head>Layer</Table.Head>\n              <Table.Head>Schema</Table.Head>\n              <Table.Head>Materialization</Table.Head>\n              <Table.Head>Columns</Table.Head>\n              <Table.Head>Last Run</Table.Head>\n            </Table.Row>\n          </Table.Header>\n          <Table.Body>\n            {filtered.map((model) => (\n              <Table.Row key={model.uniqueId}>\n                <Table.Cell>\n                  <a\n                    href={`/models/${model.name}`}\n                    className=\"text-kumo-accent hover:underline font-medium\"\n                  >\n                    {model.name}\n                  </a>\n                  {model.description && (\n                    <Text className=\"text-kumo-subtle text-xs line-clamp-1\">\n                      {model.description}\n                    </Text>\n                  )}\n                </Table.Cell>\n                <Table.Cell>\n                  <LayerBadge layer={model.layer} />\n                </Table.Cell>\n                <Table.Cell className=\"font-mono text-sm\">{model.schema}</Table.Cell>\n                <Table.Cell>\n                  <Badge variant=\"outline\">{model.materialization}</Badge>\n                </Table.Cell>\n                <Table.Cell>{model.columns.length}</Table.Cell>\n                <Table.Cell>\n                  <StatusBadge status={model.lastRunStatus} />\n                </Table.Cell>\n              </Table.Row>\n            ))}\n          </Table.Body>\n        </Table>\n      </Surface>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 2: Create model list Astro page**\n\n```astro\n---\n// data-catalog-app/src/pages/models/index.astro\nimport Layout from \"../../layouts/Layout.astro\";\nimport { AppSidebar `★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- **SSG vs SSR のトレードオフ**: Issue設計ではモデルページをSSGとしていたが、Astroの`@astrojs/cloudflare`アダプタではビルド時にR2バインディングにアクセスできない（Node.jsで実行されるため）。代わりにSSRにすることで、Workers エッジネットワーク上で低レイテンシ配信しつつR2から直接読み取り可能。用語集はGitのMDXファイルから読むのでSSG（`prerender = true`）が適切
- **Content Collections (Astro 6)**: Astro 6では`glob` loaderを使ってファイルシステムからコンテンツを読み込む。スキーマはZodで定義し、ビルド時にバリデーション。用語集のsource of truthはGit内のMDX、AI Searchへは別途R2にコピーする設計
- **AI Search API**: `env.AI.autorag("data-catalog").aiSearch(query)` の1行でRAG検索が完結する。チャンク分割、埋め込み生成、Vectorize管理がすべて自動化されるのがAutoRAGの強み

## What was implemented

**Task 2: R2 Artifacts Client + Wrangler Bindings**

### Files changed

- **`data-catalog-app/wrangler.jsonc`** — Added `DBT_ARTIFACTS` R2 bucket binding (`dbt-artifacts-modeling`), renamed worker to `data-catalog`
- **`data-catalog-app/worker-configuration.d.ts`** — Regenerated with `R2Bucket` type for `DBT_ARTIFACTS` binding
- **`data-catalog-app/package.json`** — Added `vitest` devDependency, `test` and `test:watch` scripts
- **`data-catalog-app/pnpm-lock.yaml`** — Updated lockfile
- **`data-catalog-app/vitest.config.ts`** — New: vitest config targeting `src/**/*.test.ts`
- **`data-catalog-app/src/lib/artifacts.ts`** — New: R2 artifacts client with exported functions:
  - `inferLayer(fqn)` — pure, maps fqn segments to layer enum
  - `transformManifestNode(...)` — pure, merges manifest + catalog + run_results into `CatalogModel`; handles Snowflake uppercase column names via case-insensitive matching
  - `loadAllModels(bucket)` — R2 fetch of all 3 artifact files in parallel, returns sorted models
  - `loadModel(bucket, name)` — loads by model name
  - `loadManifestMetadata(bucket)` — returns dbt version and generation timestamp
- **`data-catalog-app/src/lib/artifacts.test.ts`** — New: 9 unit tests covering all `inferLayer` branches and 4 `transformManifestNode` scenarios

### Test results

All 9 tests passed:
- 5 `inferLayer` tests (marts, staging, raw_vault, business_vault, other)
- 4 `transformManifestNode` tests (full transform, manifest-only fallback, null run result, case-insensitive column merging)

### Self-review findings

- The `R2Bucket` type used in `artifacts.ts` comes from the Cloudflare Workers global type environment (`worker-configuration.d.ts` + `@cloudflare/workers-types`), so it resolves at runtime — no import needed.
- Pure functions (`inferLayer`, `transformManifestNode`) are fully unit-testable without any R2 mock; R2-dependent functions are isolated and straightforward to integration-test later.
- Column sorting uses catalog `index` (numeric position from Snowflake), which is more reliable than insertion order.

1	import type {
2	  CatalogModel,
3	  DbtCatalogNode,
4	  DbtManifest,
5	  DbtManifestNode,
6	  DbtRunResult,
7	} from "./types";
8	
9	// Layer ordering for sorting (more specific/upstream first)
10	const LAYER_ORDER: CatalogModel["layer"][] = [
11	  "marts",
12	  "business_vault",
13	  "raw_vault",
14	  "staging",
15	  "other",
16	];
17	
18	/**
19	 * Infers the dbt layer from the model's fully-qualified name (fqn).
20	 * Scans each segment looking for known layer keywords.
21	 */
22	export function inferLayer(fqn: string[]): CatalogModel["layer"] {
23	  const known: CatalogModel["layer"][] = [
24	    "staging",
25	    "raw_vault",
26	    "business_vault",
27	    "marts",
28	  ];
29	  for (const segment of fqn) {
30	    const matched = known.find((layer) => segment === layer);
31	    if (matched) return matched;
32	  }
33	  return "other";
34	}
35	
36	/**
37	 * Transforms a single dbt manifest node into a CatalogModel.
38	 *
39	 * - Prefers catalog columns (which have runtime type info) over manifest columns.
40	 * - Uses case-insensitive key matching when looking up manifest column descriptions
41	 *   (Snowflake uppercases column names in catalog.json).
42	 * - Sorts columns by catalog index.
43	 * - Uses childMap to populate referencedBy.
44	 */
45	export function transformManifestNode(
46	  node: DbtManifestNode,
47	  catalogNode: DbtCatalogNode | undefined,
48	  runResult: DbtRunResult | undefined,
49	  childMap: Record<string, string[]>
50	): CatalogModel {
51	  // Build a lowercase -> manifest column description lookup
52	  const manifestColumnDescriptions: Record<string, string> = {};
53	  for (const [key, col] of Object.entries(node.columns)) {
54	    manifestColumnDescriptions[key.toLowerCase()] = col.description;
55	  }
56	
57	  let columns: CatalogModel["columns"];
58	
59	  if (catalogNode) {
60	    // Use catalog columns (have type info), enrich with manifest descriptions
61	    columns = Object.values(catalogNode.columns)
62	      .map((col) => ({
63	        name: col.name,
64	        type: col.type,
65	        description: manifestColumnDescriptions[col.name.toLowerCase()] ?? "",
66	        index: col.index,
67	      }))
68	      .sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index);
69	  } else {
70	    // Fall back to manifest columns only
71	    columns = Object.values(node.columns).map((col, idx) => ({
72	      name: col.name,
73	      type: col.data_type ?? "",
74	      description: col.description,
75	      index: idx + 1,
76	    }));
77	  }
78	
79	  return {
80	    uniqueId: node.unique_id,
81	    name: node.name,
82	    description: node.description,
83	    schema: node.schema,
84	    database: node.database,
85	    materialization: node.config.materialized,
86	    layer: inferLayer(node.fqn),
87	    tags: node.tags,
88	    columns,
89	    dependsOn: node.depends_on.nodes,
90	    referencedBy: childMap[node.unique_id] ?? [],
91	    lastRunStatus: runResult?.status ?? null,
92	    lastRunTime: runResult?.execution_time ?? null,
93	    path: node.path,
94	  };
95	}
96	
97	// ── R2-dependent functions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
98	
99	async function fetchJson<T>(bucket: R2Bucket, key: string): Promise<T | null> {
100	  const obj = await bucket.get(key);
101	  if (!obj) return null;
102	  return (await obj.json()) as T;
103	}
104	
105	/**
106	 * Fetches manifest.json, catalog.json, and run_results.json from R2 in parallel.
107	 * Filters to resource_type === "model" only.
108	 * Sorts by layer order (marts first) then by name.
109	 */
110	export async function loadAllModels(bucket: R2Bucket): Promise<CatalogModel[]> {
111	  const [manifest, catalog, runResults] = await Promise.all([
112	    fetchJson<DbtManifest>(bucket, "manifest.json"),
113	    fetchJson<{ nodes: Record<string, DbtCatalogNode> }>(bucket, "catalog.json"),
114	    fetchJson<{ results: DbtRunResult[] }>(bucket, "run_results.json"),
115	  ]);
116	
117	  if (!manifest) return [];
118	
119	  // Build run result lookup by unique_id
120	  const runResultMap: Record<string, DbtRunResult> = {};
121	  for (const r of runResults?.results ?? []) {
122	    runResultMap[r.unique_id] = r;
123	  }
124	
125	  const catalogNodes = catalog?.nodes ?? {};
126	
127	  const models = Object.values(manifest.nodes)
128	    .filter((node) => node.resource_type === "model")
129	    .map((node) =>
130	      transformManifestNode(
131	        node,
132	        catalogNodes[node.unique_id],
133	        runResultMap[node.unique_id],
134	        manifest.child_map
135	      )
136	    );
137	
138	  // Sort: layer order first, then alphabetically by name
139	  models.sort((a, b) => {
140	    const layerDiff =
141	      LAYER_ORDER.indexOf(a.layer) - LAYER_ORDER.indexOf(b.layer);
142	    if (layerDiff !== 0) return layerDiff;
143	    return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
144	  });
145	
146	  return models;
147	}
148	
149	/**
150	 * Loads all models and finds one by name.
151	 */
152	export async function loadModel(
153	  bucket: R2Bucket,
154	  modelName: string
155	): Promise<CatalogModel | null> {
156	  const models = await loadAllModels(bucket);
157	  return models.find((m) => m.name === modelName) ?? null;
158	}
159	
160	/**
161	 * Returns dbt version and generation timestamp from manifest metadata.
162	 */
163	export async function loadManifestMetadata(
164	  bucket: R2Bucket
165	): Promise<{ dbtVersion: string; generatedAt: string } | null> {
166	  const manifest = await fetchJson<DbtManifest>(bucket, "manifest.json");
167	  if (!manifest) return null;
168	  return {
169	    dbtVersion: manifest.metadata.dbt_version,
170	    generatedAt: manifest.metadata.generated_at,
171	  };
172	}
173

2	import { useState } from "react";
3	import type { CatalogModel } from "../lib/types";
4	
5	type Layer = CatalogModel["layer"] | "all";
6	
7	const LAYER_TABS: { value: Layer; label: string }[] = [
8	  { value: "all", label: "All Models" },
9	  { value: "marts", label: "Marts" },
10	  { value: "business_vault", label: "Business Vault" },
11	  { value: "raw_vault", label: "Raw Vault" },
12	  { value: "staging", label: "Staging" },
13	];
14	
15	function LayerBadge({ layer }: { layer: CatalogModel["layer"] }) {
16	  switch (layer) {
17	    case "marts":
18	      return <Badge variant="green">marts</Badge>;
19	    case "business_vault":
20	      return <Badge variant="purple">business_vault</Badge>;
21	    case "raw_vault":
22	      return <Badge variant="blue">raw_vault</Badge>;
23	    case "staging":
24	      return <Badge variant="orange">staging</Badge>;
25	    default:
26	      return <Badge variant="outline">{layer}</Badge>;
27	  }
28	}
29	
30	function RunStatusBadge({
31	  status,
32	}: {
33	  status: CatalogModel["lastRunStatus"];
34	}) {
35	  if (!status) return <Badge variant="outline">unknown</Badge>;
36	  switch (status) {
37	    case "success":
38	      return <Badge variant="green">success</Badge>;
39	    case "error":
40	      return <Badge variant="red">error</Badge>;
41	    case "warn":
42	      return <Badge variant="orange">warn</Badge>;
43	    default:
44	      return <Badge variant="outline">{status}</Badge>;
45	  }
46	}
47	
48	interface ModelListProps {
49	  models: CatalogModel[];
50	}
51	
52	export function ModelList({ models }: ModelListProps) {
53	  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
54	  const [selectedLayer, setSelectedLayer] = useState<Layer>("all");
55	
56	  const lowercasedSearch = search.toLowerCase();
57	
58	  const filtered = models.filter((m) => {
59	    const matchesLayer = selectedLayer === "all" || m.layer === selectedLayer;
60	    const matchesSearch =
61	      !lowercasedSearch ||
62	      m.name.toLowerCase().includes(lowercasedSearch) ||
63	      m.description.toLowerCase().includes(lowercasedSearch) ||
64	      m.schema.toLowerCase().includes(lowercasedSearch);
65	    return matchesLayer && matchesSearch;
66	  });
67	
68	  return (
69	    <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-6 p-6">
70	      <div>
71	        <Text className="text-2xl font-bold">Models</Text>
72	        <Text className="text-kumo-subtle text-sm">
73	          {models.length} model{models.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""} in this project
74	        </Text>
75	      </div>
76	
77	      <Tabs
78	        variant="underline"
79	        tabs={LAYER_TABS}
80	        selectedValue={selectedLayer}
81	        onValueChange={(v) => setSelectedLayer(v as Layer)}
82	      />
83	
84	      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
85	        <div className="flex-1">
86	          <Input
87	            aria-label="Search models"
88	            placeholder="Search by name, description, or schema..."
89	            value={search}
90	            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
91	          />
92	        </div>
93	        <Text className="text-kumo-subtle text-sm whitespace-nowrap">
94	          {filtered.length} result{filtered.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
95	        </Text>
96	      </div>
97	
98	      <Surface className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg">
99	        <Table>
100	          <Table.Header>
101	            <Table.Row>
102	              <Table.Head>Name</Table.Head>
103	              <Table.Head>Layer</Table.Head>
104	              <Table.Head>Schema</Table.Head>
105	              <Table.Head>Materialization</Table.Head>
106	              <Table.Head>Columns</Table.Head>
107	              <Table.Head>Last Run</Table.Head>
108	            </Table.Row>
109	          </Table.Header>
110	          <Table.Body>
111	            {filtered.map((model) => (
112	              <Table.Row key={model.uniqueId}>
113	                <Table.Cell>
114	                  <a
115	                    href={`/models/${model.name}`}
116	                    className="font-medium hover:underline"
117	                  >
118	                    {model.name}
119	                  </a>
120	                  {model.description && (
121	                    <div className="text-kumo-subtle text-xs mt-0.5">
122	                      {model.description}
123	                    </div>
124	                  )}
125	                </Table.Cell>
126	                <Table.Cell>
127	                  <LayerBadge layer={model.layer} />
128	                </Table.Cell>
129	                <Table.Cell>
130	                  <span className="font-mono text-sm">{model.schema}</span>
131	                </Table.Cell>
132	                <Table.Cell>
133	                  <Badge variant="outline">{model.materialization}</Badge>
134	                </Table.Cell>
135	                <Table.Cell>{model.columns.length}</Table.Cell>
136	                <Table.Cell>
137	                  <RunStatusBadge status={model.lastRunStatus} />
138	                </Table.Cell>
139	              </Table.Row>
140	            ))}
141	          </Table.Body>
142	        </Table>
143	      </Surface>
144	    </div>
145	  );
146	}
147

重要な問題を発見。Astro v6 では `Astro.locals.runtime.env` が廃止されて `import { env } from "cloudflare:workers"` に変更されています。これを修正します。

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- **Astro v6 破壊的変更**: `Astro.locals.runtime.env` は Astro v6 + @astrojs/cloudflare v13 で削除。代わりに `import { env } from "cloudflare:workers"` を使う。これはCloudflare Workers のネイティブモジュール構文で、バインディングに直接アクセスできる
- Astro 5 → 6 のマイグレーションで最も頻出するBreaking Change の一つ
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

> AGENT

ビルド成功。ご質問に回答します。

**AstroプロジェクトがR2にバインドできるようになったの？** — はい。`@astrojs/cloudflare` アダプタを使うと、Astro は Workers Static Assets としてデプロイされます。SSRページ（`prerender = false`）はCloudflare Workers上で動くので、`wrangler.jsonc` で定義したR2、KV、D1、AI等のバインディングに `import { env } from "cloudflare:workers"` でアクセスできます。これはAstro固有の機能ではなく、Workers のネイティブモジュール構文です。

**Workers AI / Agents / AI Gateway の組み込みについて** — 良い質問です。現在のアーキテクチャに組み込めるアイデア：

1. **AI Search (AutoRAG)** — 既にTask 8で組み込み済み。`data-catalog` R2バケットに格納されたMarkdownを自動インデックスして自然言語検索
2. **AI Gateway** — `wrangler.jsonc` に `ai_gateway` を追加すれば、AI Search呼び出しのキャッシュ・レートリミット・コスト監視が可能
3. **Workers AI 直接利用** — 例えば「モデル説明文の自動翻訳（日→英）」や「カラム説明の自動生成」

ただ、まずはTask 9を完了させましょう。devサーバーでの動作確認を続けます。

The Codex task completed. Here are the review findings:

---

## 1. Correctness of Cloudflare Workers bindings usage (R2, AI)

- **[high] `src/pages/api/search.ts:14`** -- `env.AI.autorag("data-catalog").aiSearch(...)` is called with a raw string, but the generated Workers types and current AI Search Workers binding expect an object payload such as `{ query }`. This is a concrete binding/API mismatch and should fail type-checking/runtime invocation.
- **[high] `src/components/SearchPage.tsx:5`** -- The UI result type does not match the AI Search response returned by the binding. The binding returns `data[]` entries with fields like `filename` and `content[]`, but the component assumes `source: string` and `content: string`, then renders `item.content` directly at `src/components/SearchPage.tsx:101`; that can produce `undefined` labels and object-as-child runtime failures.

## 2. Type safety between dbt artifacts and the UI

- **[medium] `src/lib/artifacts.ts:99`** -- `fetchJson<T>` uses `as T` on unvalidated R2 JSON, so there is no runtime type boundary between dbt artifacts and `CatalogModel` construction. Any manifest/catalog/run_results schema drift bypasses TypeScript entirely and can break SSR/UI code later while still appearing "type-safe" at compile time.

## 3. Security issues (XSS, injection)

- **[low] `src/pages/api/search.ts:19`** -- The route reflects raw exception text from the AI binding back to the browser. This is not an XSS vector by itself, but it is an information disclosure issue: provider/runtime diagnostics from AI Search are exposed to any caller instead of being normalized server-side.

## 4. Performance concerns (unnecessary re-renders, N+1 fetches)

- **[medium] `src/lib/artifacts.ts:156`** -- `loadModel()` calls `loadAllModels()`, so every `/models/:name` request rereads `manifest.json`, `catalog.json`, and `run_results.json` from R2 and rebuilds every `CatalogModel` just to find one match. That is avoidable O(total models) work per detail-page request.
- **[medium] `src/pages/models/index.astro:16`** -- `ModelList` is hydrated with `client:load`, which serializes the full `models` payload into the page and hydrates it on the client. The list UI only consumes a subset of each record, but the payload still includes columns, lineage, tags, and other unused fields.
- **[low] `src/pages/models/[name].astro:23`** -- `ModelDetail` has no local state or event handlers, but it is still `client:load` hydrated. That adds avoidable JS and prop serialization cost to every model-detail page.

## 5. Missing error handling in SSR pages

- **[medium] `src/pages/models/index.astro:10`** -- The SSR page awaits `loadAllModels(env.DBT_ARTIFACTS)` without a local `try/catch`, so any rejected R2 read or JSON parse failure becomes an unhandled 500 instead of a controlled error response.
- **[medium] `src/lib/artifacts.ts:117`** -- `loadAllModels()` silently returns `[]` when `manifest.json` is missing. On `/models`, that turns a backend/configuration failure into a misleading successful empty catalog.
- **[medium] `src/pages/models/[name].astro:15`** -- The detail page returns 404 whenever `loadModel()` returns `null`; because `loadModel()` depends on `loadAllModels()`, a missing artifact can be misreported as "Model not found" instead of surfacing a storage/configuration failure.

kumoの`Text`は`className`を**意図的に除外**しています（`Omit<..., "className" | "style">`）。代わりに`variant`/`size`プロップか`DANGEROUS_className`を使う設計です。

これは全コンポーネントに影響する大きな修正です。方針：
- kumoの`Text`は`variant`/`size`で表現できるスタイルはそちらを使う
- それ以外のカスタムスタイリングはプレーンHTML要素（`<span>`, `<p>`, `<div>`）+ Tailwindに置き換える

  "content": "import { Surface, Table, Text } from \"@cloudflare/kumo\";\nimport type { CatalogColumn } from \"../lib/types\";\n\ninterface ColumnTableProps {\n  columns: CatalogColumn[];\n}\n\nexport function ColumnTable({ columns }: ColumnTableProps) {\n  if (columns.length === 0) {\n    return (\n      <Text variant=\"secondary\" size=\"sm\">\n        No column information available.\n      </Text>\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <Surface className=\"overflow-hidden rounded-lg\">\n      <Table>\n        <Table.Header>\n          <Table.Row>\n            <Table.Head>#</Table.Head>\n            <Table.Head>Column</Table.Head>\n            <Table.Head>Type</Table.Head>\n            <Table.Head>Description</Table.Head>\n          </Table.Row>\n        </Table.Header>\n        <Table.Body>\n          {columns.map((col) => (\n            <Table.Row key={col.name}>\n              <Table.Cell>{col.index}</Table.Cell>\n              <Table.Cell>\n                <Text variant=\"mono\">{col.name}</Text>\n              </Table.Cell>\n              <Table.Cell>\n                <Text variant=\"mono-secondary\">{col.type}</Text>\n              </Table.Cell>\n              <Table.Cell>{col.description || \"—\"}</Table.Cell>\n            </Table.Row>\n          ))}\n        </Table.Body>\n      </Table>\n    </Surface>\n  );\n}\n"
}

(\n          <a key={id} href={`/models/${name}`}>\n            <Badge variant=\"outline\">{name}</Badge>\n          </a>\n        ) : (\n          <Badge key={id} variant=\"outline\">\n            {name}\n          </Badge>\n        );\n      })}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

> AGENT

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- `astro dev` はデフォルトでローカルのminiflare環境を使うため、R2バケットは空のローカルストレージ。リモートのR2バケットにアクセスするには `--remote` フラグが必要
- Astro + Cloudflare adapter では `astro dev` が内部で wrangler を使ってWorkers ランタイムをエミュレートしている
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

  "description": "Start dev server with --remote flag for R2 access",

> AGENT

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- **Astro v6 + Cloudflare Workers の `env` アクセス**: `Astro.locals.runtime.env` は廃止。`import { env } from "cloudflare:workers"` に移行済み。これはCloudflare Workers のネイティブモジュール構文
- **ローカルdev時のR2接続**: デフォルトではminiflareのローカルストレージを使うため、`wrangler.jsonc` で `"remote": true` を指定しないとリモートR2にアクセスできない
- **kumo Text コンポーネント**: `className` を意図的に排除する設計。`variant`/`size`/`bold` プロップで表現する。他のコンポーネント（Badge, Surface）は `className` 使用可
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

---

## 実装完了サマリー

**ブランチ**: `feat/data-catalog-astro-ui` (12 commits)

**実装内容**:
- **型定義**: dbt manifest/catalog/run_results の TypeScript 型 + アプリレベルの `CatalogModel` 型
- **R2クライアント**: artifacts 読み取り + 変換ロジック（Snowflake大文字カラム対応）+ Vitest 9テスト
- **モデル一覧**: SSR、レイヤータブ、検索フィルタ、R2から実データ表示（40+モデル）
- **モデル詳細**: メタデータカード、カラムテーブル、リネージュバッジ、動的ルート
- **用語集**: Content Collections（MDX）、SSGページ、Zodスキーマ
- **AI Search**: AutoRAG APIエンドポイント、検索UIページ
- **修正**: Astro v6 env移行、kumo Text props、Phosphor Icons deprecation、R2 remote binding

```
 * `MenuButton` auto-wraps in `<li>` so `MenuItem` is optional for simple items.
 *
 * @example Simple usage
 * ```tsx
 * <Sidebar.Menu>
 *   <Sidebar.MenuButton icon={HouseIcon} active>Account home</Sidebar.MenuButton>
 *   <Sidebar.MenuButton icon={GlobeIcon}>Domains</Sidebar.MenuButton>
 * </Sidebar.Menu>
 * ```
 *
 * @example With explicit MenuItem (needed for MenuAction sibling)
 * ```tsx
 * <Sidebar.Menu>
 *   <Sidebar.MenuItem>
 *     <Sidebar.MenuButton icon={GearIcon}>Settings</Sidebar.MenuButton>
 *     <Sidebar.MenuAction><PencilIcon /></Sidebar.MenuAction>
 *   </Sidebar.MenuItem>
 * </Sidebar.Menu>
 * ```
 */
declare const SidebarMenu: React.ForwardRefExoticComponent<Omit<React.DetailedHTMLProps<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLUListElement>, HTMLUListElement>, "ref"> & React.RefAttributes<HTMLUListElement>>;
/**
 * Individual menu list item. Renders as `<li>`.
 *
 * **Optional when using `MenuButton` directly** — `MenuButton` auto-wraps
 * itself in a `<li>` when not already inside a `MenuItem`. Use `MenuItem`
 * explicitly when you need to place siblings (e.g., `MenuAction`) alongside
 * a `MenuButton`.
 *
 * @example Explicit usage (needed for MenuAction sibling)
 * ```tsx
 * <Sidebar.MenuItem>
 *   <Sidebar.MenuButton icon={GearIcon}>Settings</Sidebar.MenuButton>
 *   <Sidebar.MenuAction><PencilIcon /></Sidebar.MenuAction>
 * </Sidebar.MenuItem>
 * ```
 */
declare const SidebarMenuItem: React.ForwardRefExoticComponent<Omit<React.DetailedHTMLProps<React.LiHTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement>, HTMLLIElement>, "ref"> & React.RefAttributes<HTMLLIElement>>;
export type SidebarMenuButtonSize = "base" | "sm";
export interface SidebarMenuButtonProps extends Omit<React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, "className" | "children"> {
    icon?: React.ComponentType<{
        className?: string;
    }> | React.ReactNode;
    active?: boolean;
    /**
     * Button size.
     * - `"base"` — Standard nav item
     * - `"sm"` — Compact nav item
     * @default "base"
     */
    size?: SidebarMenuButtonSize;
    href?: string;
    tooltip?: string;
    className?: string;
    children?: ReactNode;
}
/**
 * Primary interactive element inside a menu item. Renders as a `<button>` or link.
 * Supports icons, active state, and auto-tooltip when the sidebar is collapsed.
 *
 * **Auto-wraps in `<li>`** when not already inside a `Sidebar.MenuItem`.
--
 *   <Sidebar.MenuButton icon={GlobeIcon} active>Domains</Sidebar.MenuButton>
 *   <Sidebar.MenuButton icon={ClockIcon} href="/recents">Recents</Sidebar.MenuButton>
 * </Sidebar.Menu>
 * ```
 *
 * @example With MenuAction sibling (explicit MenuItem needed)
 * ```tsx
 * <Sidebar.MenuItem>
 *   <Sidebar.MenuButton icon={GearIcon}>Settings</Sidebar.MenuButton>
 *   <Sidebar.MenuAction><PencilIcon /></Sidebar.MenuAction>
 * </Sidebar.MenuItem>
 * ```
 */
declare const SidebarMenuButton: React.ForwardRefExoticComponent<SidebarMenuButtonProps & React.RefAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>>;
/**
 * Right-aligned action button inside a menu item (e.g., settings gear, plus icon).
 * Positioned absolutely so it overlays the menu button.
 * Hidden when the sidebar is collapsed.
 */
declare const SidebarMenuAction: React.ForwardRefExoticComponent<Omit<React.DetailedHTMLProps<React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, HTMLButtonElement>, "ref"> & React.RefAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>>;
/**
 * Badge pill displayed inside a menu button (e.g., "Beta", "New").
 * Uses dashed border styling matching the Cloudflare design system.
 *
--
 * `MenuButton` is used as a `Collapsible.Trigger`, Base UI sets
 * `data-panel-open` on the trigger — the chevron rotates automatically via CSS.
 *
 * @example
 * ```tsx
 * <Sidebar.CollapsibleTrigger render={<Sidebar.MenuButton icon={ComputeIcon} />}>
 *   Compute
 *   <Sidebar.MenuChevron />
 * </Sidebar.CollapsibleTrigger>
 * ```
 */
declare function SidebarMenuChevron({ className }: {
    className?: string;
}): import("react/jsx-runtime").JSX.Element;
declare namespace SidebarMenuChevron {
    var displayName: string;
--
 * Use `render` prop to compose with `Sidebar.MenuButton`.
 *
 * @example

 * <Sidebar.CollapsibleTrigger render={<Sidebar.MenuButton icon={DiamondIcon} />}>
 *   Compute
 *   <Sidebar.MenuChevron />
 * </Sidebar.CollapsibleTrigger>

 */
declare const SidebarCollapsibleTrigger: React.ForwardRefExoticComponent<Omit<import('@base-ui/react').CollapsibleTriggerProps, "ref"> & React.RefAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>>;

> AGENT

kumoのSidebar.Providerはサイドバー＋メインを包むコンテナとして機能するので、Providerをページレイアウト全体に引き上げて、サイドバーの隣にメインコンテンツを直接配置する必要があります。

AppSidebarからProviderを外してLayoutに移動するのが正しい構造です。ただしAstro上でReactの`Provider`を`.astro`ファイルで使うのは難しいので、`AppShell`という包括コンポーネントを作ります。

  "content": "---\nexport const prerender = true;\n\nimport Layout from \"../../layouts/Layout.astro\";\nimport { AppShell } from \"../../components/AppSidebar\";\nimport { getCollection } from \"astro:content\";\n\nconst entries = await getCollection(\"glossary\");\nconst byCategory = entries.reduce(\n  (acc, entry) => {\n    const cat = entry.data.category;\n    if (!acc[cat]) acc[cat] = [];\n    acc[cat].push(entry);\n    return acc;\n  },\n  {} as Record<string, typeof entries>\n);\n---\n\n<Layout title=\"用語集 — Data Catalog\">\n  <AppShell client:load>\n    <div class=\"flex flex-col gap-6\">\n      <div>\n        <h1 class=\"text-2xl font-bold\">用語集</h1>\n        <p class=\"text-kumo-subtle text-sm\">\n          {entries.length} terms defined\n        </p>\n      </div>\n\n      {Object.entries(byCategory).map(([category, items]) => (\n        <div>\n          <h2 class=\"text-lg font-semibold mb-2\">{category}</h2>\n          <div class=\"grid gap-2\">\n            {items.map((entry) => (\n              <a\n                href={`/glossary/${entry.id}`}\n                class=\"block rounded-lg border border-kumo-border p-4 hover:bg-kumo-subtle transition-colors\"\n              >\n                <span class=\"font-medium\">{entry.data.term}</span>\n                <span class=\"text-kumo-subtle text-sm ml-2\">({entry.data.termEn})</span>\n                {entry.data.relatedModels.length > 0 && (\n                  <span class=\"text-kumo-subtle text-xs ml-2\">\n                    — {entry.data.relatedModels.join(\", \")}\n                  </span>\n                )}\n              </a>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      ))}\n    </div>\n  </AppShell>\n</Layout>\n"
}

1	# 🔍 Search Snippet Library
2	
3	A production-ready, self-contained TypeScript Web Component library providing both search and chat interfaces with streaming support. Zero dependencies, fully customizable, and framework-agnostic.
4	
5	## ✨ Features
6	
7	- **🎨 Fully Customizable** - 20+ CSS variables for complete theme control
8	- **⚡ Zero Dependencies** - Self-contained with everything bundled
9	- **📱 Responsive Design** - Works seamlessly on all devices
10	- **🎭 Framework Agnostic** - Native Web Components work everywhere
11	- **♿ Accessible** - WCAG 2.1 AA compliant with ARIA support
12	- **🚀 Streaming Support** - Real-time streaming responses with low latency
13	- **🌓 Dark Mode** - Automatic theme switching based on system preferences
14	- **📦 Tiny Bundle** - Optimized for minimal size (< 50KB gzipped)
15	- **🔒 Secure** - XSS protection with HTML sanitization
16	- **⚙️ TypeScript** - Full type definitions included
17	
18	## 🚀 Quick Start
19	
20	> **Note:** This library requires an active AI Search endpoint in your Cloudflare Dashboard. Make sure to enable and configure your AI Search service before using these components.
21	
22	### Installation
23	
24	```bash
25	npm install @cloudflare/ai-search-snippet
26	# or
27	yarn add @cloudflare/ai-search-snippet
28	```
29	
30	### Basic Usage
31	
32	> **Note:** Replace `<hash>` with your Cloudflare AI Search endpoint hash (you can find it in the Cloudflare Dashboard).
33	
34	```html
35	<!-- Import the library -->
36	<script
37	  type="module"
38	  src="https:/<hash>/search.ai.cloudflare.com/search-snippet.es.js"
39	></script>
40	
41	<!-- Search bar with results -->
42	<search-bar-snippet
43	  api-url="https:/<hash>/search.ai.cloudflare.com/"
44	  placeholder="Search..."
45	  max-results="10"
46	  show-url="true"
47	  show-date="true"
48	>
49	</search-bar-snippet>
50	
51	<!-- Modal search (opens with Cmd/Ctrl+K) -->
52	<search-modal-snippet
53	  api-url="https:/<hash>/search.ai.cloudflare.com/"
54	  placeholder="Search documentation..."
55	  max-results="10"
56	  show-url="true"
57	  show-date="true"
58	>
59	</search-modal-snippet>
60	
61	<!-- Floating chat bubble -->
62	<chat-bubble-snippet
63	  api-url="https:/<hash>/search.ai.cloudflare.com/"
64	  placeholder="Type a message..."
65	>
66	</chat-bubble-snippet>
67	
68	<!-- Full-page chat with history -->
69	<chat-page-snippet
70	  api-url="https:/<hash>/search.ai.cloudflare.com/"
71	  placeholder="Type a message..."
72	>
73	</chat-page-snippet>
74	```
75	
76	## 📖 API Reference
77	
78	### Components
79	
80	The library provides four Web Components:
81	
82	| Component            | Tag                      | Description                           |
83	| -------------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------- |
84	| `SearchBarSnippet`   | `<search-bar-snippet>`   | Search input with results dropdown    |
85	| `SearchModalSnippet` | `<search-modal-snippet>` | Modal search with Cmd/Ctrl+K shortcut |
86	| `ChatBubbleSnippet`  | `<chat-bubble-snippet>`  | Floating chat bubble overlay          |
87	| `ChatPageSnippet`    | `<chat-page-snippet>`    | Full-page chat with session history   |
88	
89	### Common Attributes
90	
91	These attributes are available on all components:
92	
93	| Attribute       | Type                          | Default                 | Description                    |
94	| --------------- | ----------------------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------------ |
95	| `api-url`       | string                        | `http://localhost:3000` | API endpoint URL               |
96	| `placeholder`   | string                        | Component-specific      | Input placeholder text         |
97	| `theme`         | `'light' \| 'dark' \| 'auto'` | `'auto'`                | Color scheme                   |
98	| `hide-branding` | boolean                       | `false`                 | Hide the "Powered by" branding |
99	
100	### Search Components Attributes
```

1	import type { SearchBarSnippet, SearchModalSnippet } from '@cloudflare/ai-search-snippet';
2	import type { HTMLAttributes, RefAttributes } from 'react';
3	
4	/**
5	 * 1. Converts kebab-case-strings to camelCaseStrings
6	 */
7	type KebabToCamel<S extends string> = S extends `${infer T}-${infer U}`
8	  ? `${T}${Capitalize<KebabToCamel<U>>}`
9	  : S;
10	
11	/**
12	 * 2. Extracts the string literal union from the static observedAttributes
13	 */
14	type GetObservedAttributes<C> = C extends { observedAttributes: readonly (infer P)[] }
15	  ? P & string
16	  : never;
17	
18	/**
19	 * 3. The Core Generic: Combines attribute transformation, React HTML props, and Refs
20	 */
21	export type ReactCustomElement<
22	  Instance extends HTMLElement,
23	  Constructor extends { observedAttributes: readonly string[] },
24	> = {
25	  [K in GetObservedAttributes<Constructor> as KebabToCamel<K>]?: string | number | boolean;
26	} & HTMLAttributes<Instance> &
27	  RefAttributes<Instance>;

29	declare module 'react' {
